items.title_en: US preliminary AD review of Chinese steel nails: Yueda 9.27%; nine companies rescinded
items.title_original: Certain Steel Nails From the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Results and Rescission, in Part of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2024-2025
items.summary_zh: 【事实】美国商务部11月4日发布A-570-909行政复审初裁，复审期2024年8月1日至2025年7月31日。上海悦达钢钉及其滁州关联公司获单独税率资格，初步加权平均倾销幅度9.27%；中国统一税率118.04%本轮未复审、不变。因无可复审的暂缓清算进口记录，对附录II所列9家企业终止本次复审。案情摘要和名单均为官方初裁，并非终裁或对所有中国钢钉统一改税。公告规定利害关系方书面案情陈述须在公布后21日内提交，反驳陈述在此后5日内；听证申请应在公布后30日内通过ACCESS提交。
items.summary_en: Commerce published preliminary results for A-570-909 on 4 November 2026, covering 1 August 2024 to 31 July 2025. Shanghai Yueda Nails and its Chuzhou affiliate received a preliminary separate rate of 9.27%; the China-wide 118.04% rate was not reviewed. Nine companies were rescinded for lack of reviewable suspended entries. Case briefs are due within 21 days of publication, rebuttals five days later, and hearing requests within 30 days. These are preliminary findings, not final duty changes for all Chinese nail exports.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】涉美钢钉业务应逐家核实生产商/出口商身份、适用现金保证金和进口批次，不应把悦达9.27%用于其他钢钉企业；终止复审也不等于取消反倾销令。相关企业应在法定时限内由美国代理律师评估陈述、复核计算和听证；本次未独立取得ACCESS完整产品范围备忘录，具体HTSUS归类及适用边界须另行确认。
items.impact_en: Check exporter-specific treatment, deposits and entry history; do not apply Yueda's 9.27% to other exporters. A rescission does not revoke the AD order. Counsel should review briefing and hearing deadlines and verify product scope against the ACCESS memorandum.

items.title_en: UK steel trade measure: 3 November official page confirms 20 quota categories and 50% out-of-quota duty
items.title_original: UK's steel trade measure from 1 July 2026
items.summary_zh: 【事实】英国政府《UK's steel trade measure from 1 July 2026》官方页面标示2026年11月3日更新。该措施自7月1日起取代原保障措施，免税进口总配额较原制度减少51%，适用于列示的20类钢材产品；超配额进口加征50%从价关税，按其他进口税前货值计算，原25%保障措施附加税已于6月30日停止。按7月—次年6月配额年度分四季度，原产国单独额度及剩余（residual）额度按先到先得办理；季度未用完额度可向下一季度结转，但不跨配额年度。官方正文也明确此前10月1日起将非合金钢丝税号72173049、72173090排除在措施范围外，该两项由50%降为0%，第28类相关额度不变。最新页面仍列有第1类授权用途专用配额与对应下游加工用途。
items.summary_en: The UK government's steel trade measure page states it was updated on 3 November 2026. The measure replaced the former safeguard on 1 July 2026, cutting aggregate duty-free quota volumes by 51% versus the old safeguard and applying a 50% ad valorem out-of-quota duty to listed goods across 20 categories. Quarterly country/residual quotas operate first come, first served; unused amounts roll to the next quarter but not into a new quota year. A previously effective 1 October change removed non-alloy wire codes 72173049 and 72173090 from the measure, without changing Category 28 quota quantities. Category 1 authorised-use rules also remain set out.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】对热轧、第4类金属涂镀、第5类彩涂及其他涉英出口钢材，应按英国8位税号、当季来源国/剩余额度和进口人实际报关时点计算配额风险。不得因11月3日网页标记更新而声称当天新推出50%税或上述10月税号调整；此次网页修订的逐项文本差异尚未取得。下一步核对HMRC实时配额余额、适用配额订单号及中国原产可用额度，再确定英国CFR/DDP报价中的超额税负。
items.impact_en: For UK-bound hot-rolled, coated and other scoped steel, check the exact UK commodity code, eligible country/residual quota and clearance date before pricing. The 50% duty was not newly imposed on 3 November; the 1 October wire-code exemption is also an earlier change. The full text diff for the 3 November page revision has not been established. Confirm live HMRC balances and quota order numbers rather than treating the published annual allocation as available stock.

items.title_zh: 英国CBAM 11月3日更新净重记录规则：以进口时不含包装的公斤净重申报
items.title_en: UK CBAM record guidance updated: net mass at import, excluding packaging, in kilograms
items.title_original: Keeping records for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
items.summary_zh: 【事实】英国HMRC 11月3日更新CBAM记录保存指南的重量章节。进口CBAM货物须记录进口时不含包装的净重，单位kg，最多保留6位小数。超过1kg且带小数的重量可按0.5kg阈值四舍五入到整数公斤；不足1kg应以0.开头、最多6位小数记录并去除末尾零。报关单、商业发票、运输重量记录、提单及装箱单均可作为重量证据。2027年1月1日起的进口记录义务、通常6年保存期及2028年1月1日开放注册的时间安排未因这次重量说明改变。
items.summary_en: HMRC updated its CBAM records guidance on 3 November 2026 to specify import-time net mass excluding packaging, in kg, up to six decimal places. Fractions above 1 kg may be rounded to the nearest kg with a 0.5 kg threshold; sub-1 kg values use up to six decimals without trailing zeroes. Import declarations, invoices, carrier records, bills of lading and packing lists can substantiate weight. Existing 2027 record-keeping and 2028 registration dates are unchanged.

items.title_zh: 加拿大对中国碳钢及合金钢管线管启动反倾销、反补贴措施到期复审（RR-2026-008）
items.title_en: Canada starts expiry review RR-2026-008 of China carbon and alloy steel line pipe
items.title_original: Canadian tribunal opens review of China steel line pipe order
items.summary_zh: 【事实】加拿大国际贸易法庭（CITT）2026年11月2日宣布启动RR-2026-008到期复审，审查其2022年1月6日就中国碳钢及合金钢管线管作出的既有反倾销、反补贴命令若到期，是否可能再次发生倾销或补贴并损害加拿大产业。加拿大边境服务署（CBSA）最迟于2027年4月1日认定倾销/补贴继续或再发的可能性；如认定为肯定，CITT最迟于2027年9月8日作出损害可能性结论。有意参与者须提交Form I参与通知。该程序是对现有措施的到期复审，不是11月2日新征一个税率，也不是已决定撤销措施。
items.summary_en: On 2 November 2026 the Canadian International Trade Tribunal initiated expiry review RR-2026-008 of its 6 January 2022 order regarding dumping and subsidizing of carbon and alloy steel line pipe from China. CBSA must decide by 1 April 2027 whether dumping or subsidizing is likely to continue or recur. If affirmative, CITT must decide likely injury by 8 September 2027. Interested parties may participate by filing Form I. This is an expiry review of existing measures, not a new duty rate or a revocation.

items.title_zh: 印度钢铁对欧盟出口量上半财年降19.8%，对美洲和非洲出口转增
items.title_en: India's steel exports to the EU fall 19.8% as shipments shift toward the Americas and Africa
items.title_original: India's steel exports to EU fall 20% amid CBAM, quotas; Americas surge 262%, Africa 96%
items.summary_zh: Moneycontrol按印度商务部数据分析称，2026/27财年4—9月印度对欧盟钢铁出口量由上年同期191万吨降至153万吨，同比下降19.8%；出口额由17.9亿美元降至14.8亿美元，下降17%。9月出口量同比下降50.4%至197,433吨，是二季度出口收缩的主要来源。同期对非洲出口量增长96%、出口额增长76.5%至3.342亿美元；对美洲出口量增长262%、出口额增长117.1%至14.2亿美元。欧盟2026/1384号条例及2026/1457号实施条例确认，7月1日起26类钢材年度免附加税配额总量为18,345,922吨，超配额附加税率为50%；但贸易数据本身不能证明印度某一产品配额已在9月耗尽，也不能把出口下降全部归因于配额或CBAM。
items.summary_en: Moneycontrol's analysis of Indian commerce-ministry data says April–September 2026/27 steel exports to the EU fell 19.8% by volume to 1.53Mt from 1.91Mt and 17% by value to USD1.48bn. September volume fell 50.4% year on year to 197,433t. Over the same period, volumes to Africa rose 96% and to the Americas 262%. EU Regulations 2026/1384 and 2026/1457 confirm an annual 18,345,922t quota across 26 categories and a 50% out-of-quota duty from 1 July, but the trade data do not prove that a particular Indian product quota was exhausted or that quotas and CBAM caused the entire decline.
items.impact_zh: 印度出口向美洲和非洲加速转移，可能增加中国钢材在这些市场的价格、交期和贸易救济竞争；中国出口商应按目的国、产品和季度跟踪印度流量、当地进口措施及自身利润，不能把印度总量变化直接套用于中国订单。对欧业务仍须逐产品核对欧盟季度配额余额、50%超配额附加税及CBAM产品排放数据；本条没有形成新的中国适用税率或配额。
items.impact_en: India's shift toward the Americas and Africa may intensify price, delivery and trade-remedy competition for Chinese steel in those markets. Chinese exporters should track flows by destination, product and quarter rather than extrapolate India's aggregate data to their own orders. EU sales still require product-level quota, 50% out-of-quota duty and CBAM data checks; this report creates no new China-specific rate or quota.

items.title_zh: 中国铁水产量降幅小于预期，铁矿石期价小幅反弹但四季度供应压力仍在
items.title_en: Iron ore edges higher as China's hot-metal decline proves smaller than expected
items.title_original: Iron-Ore Prices Rise After Sharp Declines as Chinese Demand Holds Up
items.summary_zh: 11月2日市场报道显示，大商所主力铁矿石合约在北京时间早盘上涨0.59%至679元/吨，新交所12月合约上涨0.61%至91.3美元/吨；此前两者在9月和10月均连续下跌。Mysteel样本钢厂截至10月29日的日均铁水产量环比仅下降0.2%至约232万吨，降幅小于市场对检修、亏损及北方环保减产的预期。国信期货认为价格接近支撑位后情绪有所恢复，但四季度供应过剩和钢厂盈利偏弱仍限制上行。同期上期所螺纹钢、热卷分别下跌0.59%和0.57%，不锈钢上涨0.34%。
items.summary_en: A 2 November market report said DCE iron ore rose 0.59% to CNY679/t and SGX December iron ore gained 0.61% to USD91.3/t after two monthly declines. Mysteel's surveyed daily hot-metal output fell only 0.2% week on week to about 2.32Mt as of 29 October, less than expected despite maintenance, weak margins and temporary northern output cuts. Guoxin Futures saw support-level stabilisation, while Q4 surplus risk and weak mill margins still capped upside. SHFE rebar and HRC fell 0.59% and 0.57%, while stainless rose 0.34%.
items.impact_zh: 本次反弹主要反映铁水降幅不及预期和技术性支撑，不能据此判断钢材终端需求或出口订单已转强。中国钢厂应把铁水、利润、港口库存和到港量共同纳入采购节奏，避免用单日DCE/SGX涨幅锁定中长期矿价；出口报价仍应基于钢材实际成本、汇率和目标市场贸易措施。
items.impact_en: The move reflects a smaller-than-expected hot-metal decline and technical support, not proof of stronger end demand or export orders. Mills should combine hot-metal output, margins, inventories and arrivals when planning ore purchases rather than extrapolate one trading session.

items.summary_zh: 中钢协10月30日三季度发布会及《中国冶金报》评论显示，前三季度全国粗钢产量7.25亿吨、同比下降2.9%，折合粗钢表观消费量6.25亿吨、下降3.8%，需求降幅大于产量降幅；重点会员企业平均钢材库存1,685万吨，为近四年同期最高，9月会员企业利润总额22.4亿元、环比下降55.8%，钢铁主业亏损46.1亿元。中钢协评估约10家企业执行“以销定产、以效定产、以现定销”等原则不够坚决，将进行行业自律提醒，并要求控制生产节奏、降低库存。该安排是行业协会自律与经营倡议，不是政府下达的全国强制减产指标。
items.summary_en: At its 30 October briefing, CISA said Jan–Sep crude steel output was 725Mt, down 2.9%, while apparent consumption fell 3.8% to 625Mt. Key member mills' average finished-steel inventory was 16.85Mt, the highest in four years. September member profits fell 55.8% month on month to CNY2.24bn and core steel operations lost CNY4.61bn. CISA said about ten mills had not followed its sales-, efficiency- and cash-based production principles firmly enough and would receive self-discipline reminders. This is an industry-association initiative, not a mandatory nationwide government cut.
items.impact_zh: 若会员钢厂后续真正减产并去库存，短期可能缓解国内钢价和出口低价竞争压力，同时压低铁矿石、焦煤和焦炭需求；但目前没有统一减产量、企业名单或强制执行期限，不能据此推断供应必然收缩。中国钢厂应按订单、边际利润和现金回款安排产量；出口商需关注约11月7日海关数据、11月中旬10月粗钢产量及库存是否实际下降，再调整远期报价和原料采购。
items.impact_en: If mills actually cut output and destock, domestic and export price pressure may ease while raw-material demand weakens. No uniform tonnage target, named mill list or mandatory deadline exists, so supply contraction is not assured. Base production on orders, margins and cash collection, and verify customs, October output and inventory data before changing forward offers.

items.summary_zh: 【事实】英国税务海关总署（HMRC）11月2日更新《Work out your Carbon Price Relief》。申请英国CBAM已付碳价抵扣，须证明进口货物的相关排放已受符合资格的碳定价制度约束，并持有涵盖进口前两个日历年度之一、经独立核验的碳价核验表。有效碳价按装置受不同碳价要素约束的排放量与相应价格加权计算，免费配额等无价格部分不计价，并扣除适用补偿。抵扣金额按有效碳价乘以符合条件的产品嵌入排放量计算；11月2日新增说明：该排放量应与CBAM申报一致，可按该批货物采用实际排放值或默认值。外币抵扣须使用HMRC公布的、进口前一季度适用汇率换算为英镑；总抵扣不得超过该批货物应缴英国CBAM税额。此为实施指南的解释性更新，并非宣布新增税率。
items.summary_en: HMRC updated its Carbon Price Relief (CPR) guidance on 2 November 2026. A claimant needs a qualifying carbon-pricing scheme and an independently verified carbon-pricing form covering one of the two calendar years preceding importation. The effective price accounts for differently priced emissions, excluding unpriced free allocations and deducting relevant compensation. The update clarifies that eligible embedded emissions used for relief must match the CBAM return and may use actual or default values as reported. HMRC's prior-quarter FX rate converts foreign-currency relief to GBP; relief cannot exceed the CBAM liability. This is guidance, not a new UK CBAM rate.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】对拟于2027年起向英国出口钢铁的中国生产商，应提前整理装置碳价缴纳、免费分配、补偿及排放核验材料，并确认采购方/英国进口商能否取得合格证明；不能因中国有碳市场或采用默认排放值，就推定必然可抵扣。报价和合同CBAM条款应分别列示毛CBAM成本与可能抵扣额。下一步核对HMRC认可的碳定价机制清单、钢材商品编码及最终适用核验文件。
items.impact_en: Chinese steel exporters should compile verified installation emissions, actual carbon-price payment, free allocation and compensation evidence, and confirm the importer can substantiate a qualifying scheme. Default emissions values do not automatically establish an entitlement to relief. Price UK business on gross CBAM exposure and separately evidenced relief, subject to the applicable commodity scope and HMRC documentation.

items.title_zh: 中钢协：中板增产491万吨、钢筋减产1718万吨，钢材结构继续向制造业调整
items.title_en: CISA: plate output rises 4.91Mt while rebar falls 17.18Mt as steel mix shifts toward manufacturing
items.title_original: 今年前三季度 我国钢铁品种不断调整优化
items.summary_zh: 央视网稿件经中新网转载显示，2026年前三季度中国粗钢产量7.25亿吨；中板产量同比增加491万吨，是增量最大品种，钢筋产量同比减少1718万吨，是减量最大品种。制造业用钢占比在2025年首次超过建筑业、达到51%，2026年上半年升至52%。同期钢材出口8564万吨、同比下降2.6%，出口均价709美元／吨、上升1.8%，进口钢材407万吨、下降10.5%。截至9月底，307家钢企完成或部分完成超低排放改造和评估监测，其中282家全过程完成、涉及粗钢产能约9.4亿吨；143家企业、7.5亿吨粗钢产能参加极致能效培育，三年累计节能超过2400万吨标准煤、减排二氧化碳6000万吨。
items.summary_en: A CCTV report republished by China News Service says China produced 725Mt of crude steel in January-September 2026. Plate output rose 4.91Mt year on year, the largest product increase, while rebar fell 17.18Mt, the largest decline. Manufacturing's share of steel use first exceeded construction in 2025 at 51% and reached 52% in H1 2026. Steel exports were 85.64Mt (-2.6%) at an average USD 709/t (+1.8%), while imports fell 10.5% to 4.07Mt. By end-September, 307 mills had completed all or part of ultra-low-emission retrofits and assessment, including 282 fully completed sites covering about 940Mt of crude-steel capacity. CISA's three-year efficiency programme involved 143 firms and 750Mt of capacity, reporting more than 24Mtce of energy savings and 60Mt of CO2 reductions.
items.impact_zh: 中板增、钢筋减以及制造业用钢占比上升，说明需求和产品结构正从地产相关长材向制造业板材、高性能和特种钢倾斜；钢厂应按真实订单、认证周期和产品盈利调整品种，而不是把协会数据理解为行政性品种配额。出口量下降、均价上升也不等同于所有企业利润改善。超低排放和节能数据是中钢协汇总口径，不能直接作为单厂、单产品的CBAM实际排放值或第三方核查结果；出口企业仍需建立产品级排放数据和可验证证据链。
items.impact_en: Higher plate and lower rebar output, together with a rising manufacturing share, point to a shift from property-linked long products toward manufacturing plate and higher-specification steel. Mills should adjust their mix against real orders, qualification cycles and margins rather than treat association data as an administrative quota. Lower export volume and a higher average price do not prove better margins for every producer. CISA's aggregate retrofit and energy-saving figures are not installation- or product-level CBAM actual emissions or third-party verification; exporters still need auditable product data.

items.title_zh: 英国钢贸会议预计2027年价格承压上行，CBAM与配额风险正进入合同条款
items.title_en: UK steel meeting expects 2027 price pressure as CBAM and quota risks move into contracts
items.title_original: UK steel industry expects higher prices in 2027; concerns that fabricated goods imports undermine safeguards and CBAM
items.summary_zh: EUROMETAL对10月22日ISTA与NSA利兹年会的报道显示，参会者认为英国钢市仍由供应主导、终端需求偏弱但未继续收缩，2027年价格可能上升。报道援引英国商务与贸易部截至10月26日数据称，热轧卷“其他国家”配额已用尽，印度8,364吨配额使用94%，韩国2,196吨配额使用20.3%，欧盟93,750吨配额已使用65,700吨。由于英国CBAM最终成本受核查和轧制料投入透明度影响，买卖双方正讨论成本分摊或事后调整条款；部分卖方转向DAP以限制超配额税费风险。参会者还担心制成钢品进口绕开上游配额并削弱CBAM效果，但该说法是行业风险判断，不是政府已认定规避或已经扩围。
items.summary_en: EUROMETAL's report on the 22 October ISTA/NSA meeting in Leeds said the UK market remained supply-driven, with weak but not contracting demand and expectations of higher 2027 prices. Citing DBT data as of 26 October, it said the residual HRC quota was exhausted, India had used 94% of 8,364t, South Korea 20.3% of 2,196t, and the EU 65,700t of 93,750t. Verification and input-transparency uncertainty is prompting CBAM true-up or risk-sharing clauses and some DAP offers. Concerns about fabricated-goods imports are industry views, not a government circumvention finding or enacted scope expansion.
items.impact_zh: 对输英钢材业务，2027年报价应把配额外关税、英国CBAM、核查失败和港口滞期费拆开列示，并在合同中明确DAP/DDP责任、适用配额时点、碳数据交付、最终税额调整及发票凭证。不能把会议上的涨价预期当成确定行情，也不能假定制成钢品已纳入现行配额或英国CBAM；实际报关前须按英国官方8位商品编码、实时配额余额和正式税率复核。
items.impact_en: For UK-bound steel, separate out-of-quota duty, UK CBAM, verification failure and demurrage risks, and define DAP/DDP responsibility, quota timing, emissions-data delivery and tax true-ups. Treat the price outlook as market opinion and verify 8-digit codes, live quota balances and enacted rates before customs clearance.

items.title_zh: 意大利铸造业协会称欧盟钢铁配额和CBAM造成上下游成本不对称
items.title_en: Italian foundry association says EU steel quotas and CBAM create an upstream-downstream cost asymmetry
items.title_original: Steel: Confimi’s Italian foundries take on Brussels – tariffs and the CBAM are hurting the supply chain
items.summary_zh: Eunews完整报道及Confimi Industria Meccanica声明称，参加帕多瓦会议的铸造和机械企业中“近30%”出现订单下降；协会认为，原材料钢进口超过欧盟配额后承担50%从价税，而部分半成品、铸件和下游部件未受到同等贸易防御或CBAM约束，造成成本不对称。协会主席Flavio Lorenzin还称，自2025年11月以来，碳钢、不锈钢和铝成本平均分别上升13%、16%和37%，并要求调整进口税、能源和监管成本，同时在CBAM谈判中纳入半成品、铸件和部件。官方交叉核对确认：Regulation (EU) 2026/1384自2026年7月1日起实施18.3百万吨年度免税配额及配额外50%税率；CBAM下游扩围仍是2025/0419(COD)立法提案，不能把协会诉求写成已通过规则。
items.summary_en: Eunews and Confimi Industria Meccanica report that nearly 30% of foundry and engineering companies represented at a Padua event had lost orders. The association argues that the 50% out-of-quota steel duty and CBAM leave some semi-finished goods, castings and components outside equivalent treatment, creating a cost asymmetry. It cites average cost increases since November 2025 of 13% for carbon steel, 16% for stainless steel and 37% for aluminium. Official checks confirm that Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 applies an 18.3Mt annual quota and 50% out-of-quota duty from 1 July 2026; downstream CBAM expansion remains proposal 2025/0419(COD), not adopted law.
items.impact_zh: 这是意大利行业协会的调查和政策立场，不是欧盟对损失订单、成本涨幅或扩围范围的官方认定。对中国钢厂而言，现行钢铁配额外50%税率已构成实际市场准入约束；同时，若未来CBAM扩大到更多下游制成品，原材料与部件之间的成本差可能收窄。出口商应按CN产品类别和配额余额核价，并跟踪2025/0419(COD)最终附件；不能根据协会发言预设半成品或部件已纳入CBAM。
items.impact_en: This is an association survey and policy position, not an EU finding on lost orders, cost inflation or final CBAM scope. Chinese exporters already face the 50% out-of-quota steel duty where quotas are exhausted. They should price by CN category and quota balance and monitor the final annex to 2025/0419(COD), without assuming downstream goods are already covered.

items.title_zh: 港口库存升至1.5372亿吨，铁矿石期货跌破680元／吨
items.title_en: Iron ore futures fall below CNY 680/t as port stocks reach 153.72Mt
items.title_original: Iron Ore Futures Near Four-Year Lows on Rising China Port Stocks, Weak Mill Profitability
items.summary_zh: IndexBox 10月30日市场简报称，铁矿石期货跌破680元／吨、接近四年低位；其引用的行业数据称，中国主要港口库存周环比增加近1%至1.5372亿吨，澳大利亚和巴西以外生产国发运维持高位，钢厂盈利比例为11.26%、与前一周持平。北方部分省份环保限制继续压低铁水产量，但限制解除后可能恢复；淡水河谷另报第三季度核心利润下降20%，归因于矿价走低及燃料、运费成本偏高。该文是即时市场报道，价格、库存和盈利比例并非官方统计序列。
items.summary_en: IndexBox reported on 30 October that iron ore futures fell below CNY 680/t toward four-year lows. Cited industry data put major Chinese port stocks at 153.72Mt, up nearly 1% week on week, and the share of profitable steel mills at 11.26%, unchanged. Environmental curbs constrained hot-metal output in northern provinces, while Vale reported a 20% fall in third-quarter core profit. These are market-series figures, not official statistics.
items.impact_zh: 库存增加和低盈利比例说明矿价反弹基础仍弱，但单日价格不能直接证明钢厂利润将改善或必须减产。钢厂应同时看焦煤、焦炭、成材价格、库存结构和到港节奏，按采购窗口管理原料风险；贸易商应标明期货合约、交割月份和数据来源，避免把“接近四年低位”当作长期价格底部。
items.impact_en: Higher stocks and a low profitable-mill ratio point to weak support, but a one-day futures move does not prove margins will recover or mills must cut output. Mills should assess coking coal, coke, finished-steel prices, stock composition and arrivals together, and traders should identify the contract and data source rather than treat a near-four-year low as a durable floor.

items.summary_zh: 宝钢股份2026年第三季度报告显示，第三季度营业收入849.16亿元、同比增长4.75%，归母净利润21.67亿元、同比下降29.67%，扣非归母净利润19.61亿元、同比下降40.50%；前三季度营业收入2456.48亿元、同比增长5.68%，归母净利润67.39亿元、同比下降15.33%，扣非归母净利润64.93亿元、同比下降19.20%。前三季度铁产量3660.5万吨、钢产量3863.2万吨、商品坯材销量3915.0万吨、合并利润86.1亿元；出口接单量587.3万吨，同比增加70.4万吨。公司称单位铁水、物流、能源及质量成本同口径分别下降3%、6%、4%和16%。财务报表未经审计。
items.summary_en: Baosteel's unaudited third-quarter report shows Q3 revenue of CNY 84.916bn (+4.75% y/y), attributable net profit of CNY 2.167bn (-29.67%) and adjusted attributable profit of CNY 1.961bn (-40.50%). For January–September, revenue was CNY 245.648bn (+5.68%), attributable net profit CNY 6.739bn (-15.33%) and adjusted profit CNY 6.493bn (-19.20%). Nine-month steel output was 38.632Mt, saleable billet and product sales 39.150Mt, consolidated profit CNY 8.61bn, and export orders 5.873Mt, up 0.704Mt.
items.impact_zh: 收入增长但利润下降，说明吨钢盈利仍受钢价、原燃料及结构因素挤压；与此同时，产销量和出口接单增长并不支持简单推断宝钢正在减产。采购方和竞争对手应把5.873百万吨出口接单视为公司口径的订单量，而非已报关出口量，并继续跟踪第四季度交付、价格和库存。成本改善是公司披露的同口径指标，不能替代外部审计或推导单个产品利润。
items.impact_en: Revenue growth alongside lower profit indicates margin pressure, while higher output, sales and export orders do not support a simple production-cut conclusion. Treat the 5.873Mt figure as company-reported export orders, not customs-cleared exports, and monitor Q4 delivery, pricing and stocks. Company cost-improvement metrics are not an audit of product-level margins.

items.title_zh: 中钢协：前三季度钢铁供强需弱、库存高位，重点企业利润下降27.4%
items.title_en: CISA says nine-month steel supply outpaced demand as key-member profits fell 27.4%
items.title_original: 【新华解读】供需失衡、成本上涨 钢铁行业低利润运行
items.summary_zh: 新华财经对中钢协三季度信息发布会的完整报道显示，2026年前三季度全国粗钢产量7.25亿吨、同比下降2.9%，折合粗钢表观消费量6.25亿吨、下降3.8%；钢材出口8564万吨、下降2.6%，出口均价709美元／吨、上升1.8%。重点统计企业平均钢材库存1685万吨，为近四年最高；CSPI平均92.28点、同比下降1.48%，为近十年同期最低。重点企业营业收入4.57万亿元、下降2.3%，营业成本4.29万亿元、下降1.9%，利润总额718亿元、下降27.4%。炼焦煤、冶金焦、喷吹煤和国产铁精矿采购成本分别上涨20.45%、16.66%、16.06%和0.15%，进口粉矿下降1.31%。中钢协副会长唐祖君称行业主要矛盾仍是供强需弱，并倡导“以销定产、以效定产、以现定销”。
items.summary_en: Xinhua Finance's full report on CISA's Q3 briefing says January–September crude-steel output was 725Mt (-2.9%), apparent crude-steel consumption 625Mt (-3.8%), steel exports 85.64Mt (-2.6%) and average export price USD 709/t (+1.8%). Key-member average finished-steel stocks were 16.85Mt, the highest in four years, while the average CSPI was 92.28, the lowest comparable level in a decade. Key members reported CNY 4.57tn revenue (-2.3%) and CNY 71.8bn total profit (-27.4%). Coking-coal, coke and PCI-coal purchase costs rose 20.45%, 16.66% and 16.06%.
items.impact_zh: 需求降幅大于产量降幅、库存高位和焦煤焦炭成本上升共同压缩利润，出口量下降但出口均价回升，不能只凭出口均价判断盈利改善。钢厂应按订单、现金回款和边际贡献落实动态产销平衡，控制成品库存与高成本原料敞口；出口部门应继续按目的国贸易救济、配额和CBAM要求筛选订单。协会“三定三不要”属于行业自律和经营倡议，不是行政限产或新的出口配额。
items.impact_en: Consumption fell faster than output, high stocks and higher coal/coke costs squeezed margins, while a higher average export price does not prove better profitability. Mills should align output with orders, cash collection and marginal contribution, manage finished-goods and raw-material exposure, and screen exports for trade remedies, quotas and CBAM. CISA's operating principles are industry guidance, not an administrative production cut or export quota.

items.title_zh: 欧英不锈钢进口配额趋紧：部分配额已用尽，英国CBAM默认值将放大数据不足成本
items.title_en: EU and UK stainless quotas tighten; UK CBAM defaults raise the cost of missing data
items.title_original: EU & UK Stainless Steel Quotas Tighten: Higher Tariffs, CBAM Costs Ahead
items.summary_zh: MEPS对2026年第四季度配额使用情况的分析显示，欧盟不锈钢棒及轻型材的“其他国家”溢出配额2,399吨已用尽，截至10月15日超额申请14,858吨；印度国别配额23,139吨也已用尽，而中国、日本和韩国国别配额尚有余额。欧盟无缝不锈钢管的FTA/国别溢出配额亦超额申请逾750吨，印度3,832吨和“其他国家”774吨配额已用尽。英国方面，截至10月15日，欧盟来源不锈钢棒及轻型材4,135吨配额约78%尚未使用，但其他来源棒材/轻型材590吨和盘条59吨已用尽；土耳其“其他焊管”第四季度3,629吨配额已用尽。英欧自7月1日起缩减钢铁配额并将超额税率提高至50%。MEPS按英国官方示例税率£9.69/tCO₂e测算，部分冷轧不锈钢默认值5.347—6.746 tCO₂e/t对应约£51.81—£65.36/t；这只是示例税率乘默认值的情景，不是正式2027年应缴税额。英国首季正式CBAM税率仍须在2026年底前发布。
items.summary_en: MEPS reports that the EU's 2,399t overflow quota for stainless bars and light sections was exhausted and over-allocated by 14,858t by 15 October; India's 23,139t country quota was also exhausted, while China, Japan and Korea still had balances. EU seamless stainless tube overflow and India/other-country quotas were likewise exhausted. In the UK, about 78% of the 4,135t EU quota for stainless bars and light sections remained, but small residual quotas and Türkiye's 3,629t other-welded-tube quota were exhausted. MEPS multiplies official UK default values by the illustrative £9.69/tCO2e rate to show roughly £51.81–£65.36/t for certain cold-rolled stainless products. This is a scenario, not the official 2027 liability.
items.impact_zh: 中国不锈钢出口商不能只看50%超额税率，应按目的市场、产品类别、原产地和到港季度逐票核对配额余额；中国国别配额尚有余额不等于所有不锈钢品类均可免税。对英订单应立即向客户提供8位CN编码、净重、生产装置和可核证实际排放，并在合同中明确配额用尽、CBAM默认值、核查费及碳价减免的承担方。缺少实际排放数据时，英国进口商可用默认值，但由此测算的成本可能高于企业实际排放；正式报价须等待季度正式税率并核对具体编码，不能把£51.81—£65.36/t直接套用于所有产品。
items.impact_en: Check quota balances by market, product category, origin and arrival quarter; remaining China-specific balances do not cover every stainless product. For UK orders, provide the eight-digit CN code, net mass, installation and verifiable actual emissions, and allocate quota, default-value, verification and carbon-price-relief risks in contracts. Do not apply the modelled £51.81–£65.36/t universally; use the official quarterly rate and product code.

items.summary_en: On 30 October 2026 the UK ETS Authority updated the installation allocation table for activity-level changes. The table covers 2021–2026, with 2026 treated as an extension of the current period. Verified 2023 activity data determine 2026 allocations for first-time recipients and newly eligible sub-installations. Operators moving to the 2026–2030 Hospital and Small Emitter or Ultra-Small Emitter lists receive no free allocation in 2026. Blank Standard (A) and NER (B) cells with only Total (C) indicate figures still under review through the 2025 activity-level-change process.

items.title_zh: 中国35港铁矿石库存升至1.4805亿吨，日均疏港量回落
items.title_en: China's 35-port iron ore stocks reach 148.05Mt as daily port pick-up slows
items.title_original: China Iron Ore Port Stocks Rise to 148.05 Million Tons as Demand Softens
items.summary_zh: SMM 10月30日数据显示，中国35个主要港口铁矿石库存为1.4805亿吨，环比增加30万吨；日均疏港量减少3.5万吨至317.5万吨。本周港口到货明显增加，而钢厂高炉铁水产量下降，下游采购偏谨慎，供需边际走弱并带来小幅累库。SMM预计下一周钢厂需求仍偏弱、铁水产量可能继续下降，疏港量难明显改善，港口库存或继续增加；这一段属于机构短期判断，不是已发生的确定结果。
items.summary_en: SMM data for 30 October put iron ore inventories across 35 major Chinese ports at 148.05Mt, up 0.30Mt on the reported comparison, while average daily port pick-up fell by 0.035Mt to 3.175Mt. Port arrivals rose notably during the week, blast-furnace hot-metal output declined and downstream purchasing remained cautious, producing a slight inventory build. SMM expects subdued mill demand, potentially lower hot-metal output and little improvement in port pick-up next week, but that is a short-term forecast rather than an observed outcome.
items.impact_zh: 35港口径的库存上升、疏港回落和铁水下降共同显示钢厂补库意愿偏弱，短期不利于铁矿石需求和价格支撑。钢厂可继续按生产节奏和边际利润安排刚需采购，贸易商应同步跟踪港口到货、钢厂利润、铁水复产及成材需求。该数据来自SMM模型和市场调研，并非海关或统计局官方数据；也不能与其他机构覆盖港口数量不同的库存口径直接比较。
items.impact_en: Rising stocks on SMM's 35-port measure, slower port pick-up and lower hot-metal output point to weak mill restocking and softer near-term support for ore demand and prices. Mills can keep procurement aligned with production and marginal profitability, while traders should monitor arrivals, mill margins, hot-metal restarts and finished-steel demand. These are SMM market-research data, not customs or official statistical data, and should not be compared directly with inventory series covering a different port universe.

items.title_original: How CBAM will widen the premium for high-grade iron ore
items.summary_zh: Fastmarkets建模认为，高品位矿可减少渣量、熔剂、焦炭或电耗及铁损，CBAM与欧盟ETS免费配额在2026—2038年逐步退出可能放大其价值。在其敏感性情景中，DRI-EAF由67.5% Fe球团改用65% Fe球团，2026年非碳成本约增加41欧元/吨热轧卷，到2035年约85欧元/吨；相应额外CBAM成本按其碳价和政策假设约由1欧元增至13欧元/吨。BF-BOF路线使用较低品位矿的额外排放约25千克CO₂/吨热轧卷，额外CBAM成本模型值约为2026年2欧元、2030年3欧元、2035年7欧元/吨。上述均为行业模型结果，不是欧盟法定加价或所有中国钢材的税额。欧盟官方规则确认：钢铁使用默认值时，2026、2027、2028年及以后分别加成10%、20%、30%。
items.summary_en: Fastmarkets models how higher-grade ore can reduce slag, fluxes, coke or electricity use and iron losses, with CBAM and the 2026–2038 phase-out of EU ETS free allocation potentially widening the value gap. Its DRI-EAF sensitivity puts the non-carbon penalty from switching 67.5% Fe pellets to 65% at about EUR41/t HRC in 2026 and EUR85/t by 2035, with additional modelled CBAM cost rising from about EUR1 to EUR13/t. For BF-BOF, it models roughly 25kg CO2/t HRC of extra emissions and additional CBAM cost of EUR2 in 2026, EUR3 in 2030 and EUR7 in 2035. These are model outputs, not statutory EU surcharges or universal China rates. Official EU rules apply default-value mark-ups of 10% in 2026, 20% in 2027 and 30% from 2028 for iron and steel.
items.impact_zh: 对中国高炉—转炉及DRI/EAF钢厂，第一优先不是为CBAM盲目追高品位矿，而是取得欧盟可接受的装置级及产品级实际排放核证；使用默认值时，企业自身的矿石优化不会直接反映在申报排放值中。完成核证后，再把矿价、成材率、渣量、焦比或电耗、实际排放、EU ETS价格和合同责任纳入同一测算。文中的2、7、13、41和85欧元/吨均不能直接套用于首钢或任何具体订单。
items.impact_en: For Chinese BF-BOF and DRI/EAF producers, securing acceptable verified installation and product emissions data comes before paying blindly for higher-grade ore. If defaults are used, a producer's own ore optimisation is not reflected directly in the declared value. After verification, compare ore premiums against yield, slag, coke or electricity use, actual emissions, ETS prices and contractual responsibility. The article's EUR figures cannot be applied directly to a specific mill or order.

items.title_zh: 首钢股份三季度转亏：前三季归母净利同比下降69.87%，采购现金支出增加
items.title_en: Beijing Shougang swings to a Q3 loss; nine-month attributable profit falls 69.87%
items.title_original: Beijing Shougang Co : Q3 swung to a net loss as weaker steel profitability drove sharp YTD earnings and cash-flow declines
items.summary_zh: 首钢股份正式发布2026年第三季度报告（未经审计）。第三季度营业收入248.34亿元，同比增加0.36%；归母净亏损2.61亿元，上年同期经重述为盈利2.99亿元；扣非净亏损2.55亿元。前三季营业收入757.54亿元，同比下降2.04%；归母净利润2.89亿元，同比下降69.87%；扣非净利润2.69亿元，同比下降72.80%；经营活动现金流净额11.22亿元，同比下降79.55%。公司称利润下滑主要因钢材产品吨钢利润及参股企业盈利水平降低；经营现金流下滑主要因支持采购市场运作的现金支付增加，预付款增加还受煤、焦炭价格上涨影响。报告未披露新增产能、停产安排或出口计划。
items.summary_en: Beijing Shougang's unaudited Q3 2026 report shows quarterly revenue of RMB24.834bn, up 0.36%, and an attributable net loss of RMB260.7m versus a restated RMB298.9m profit a year earlier. Nine-month revenue fell 2.04% to RMB75.754bn; attributable profit fell 69.87% to RMB288.9m, adjusted profit fell 72.80% to RMB268.8m, and operating cash flow fell 79.55% to RMB1.122bn. The company cited lower per-ton steel profitability and investee earnings, while higher procurement-related cash payments reduced operating cash flow. The report discloses no new capacity, shutdown or export plan.
items.impact_zh: 这是主要钢企经营信号，不是贸易政策。中国钢厂和出口业务不应把单季亏损直接转化为确定的减产或涨价判断；应跟踪吨钢利润、煤焦成本、采购现金占用以及后续产销安排。涉及欧盟或其他海外订单，仍须按具体产品、合同、配额、贸易救济和CBAM成本独立报价。在公司披露产量、出口或供应策略前，不能据本报告推断供应收缩。
items.impact_en: This is a corporate operating signal, not a trade rule. Do not infer definite production cuts or price rises from one quarterly loss. Monitor per-ton margins, coal and coke costs, procurement cash use and later production/sales guidance, while pricing export orders by product, contract, quota, trade-remedy and CBAM exposure.

items.title_zh: 美国续行中国一次性钢瓶反倾销、反补贴令，10月14日起继续有效
items.title_en: US continues AD/CVD orders on Chinese non-refillable steel cylinders effective 14 October
items.title_original: Non-Refillable Steel Cylinders From the People's Republic of China: Continuation of Antidumping Duty Order and Countervailing Duty Order
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部根据其与USITC在首次五年日落复审中的肯定裁定，正式续行对中国一次性钢瓶的反倾销令A-570-126和反补贴令C-570-127，有效日期为2026年10月14日。范围包括符合或按照美国交通部Specification 39、加拿大39M或ISO 11118制造的焊接或钎焊便携式不可重复充装钢瓶，水容积300立方英寸（4.9升）至1526立方英寸（25升），可带或不带阀门/泄压装置、进口时可为空瓶；装压缩空气且符合描述的产品也包括。无缝一次性钢瓶明确排除。列示HTSUS 7311.00.0060、7311.00.0090，并可能从7310.29.0025、7310.29.0050进入，但书面范围优先。美国海关将继续按进口时有效税率收取反倾销和反补贴现金保证金；本通知没有公布一项适用于所有企业的新统一税率。
items.summary_en: Commerce has continued AD order A-570-126 and CVD order C-570-127 on non-refillable steel cylinders from China following affirmative Commerce and USITC sunset-review determinations, effective 14 October 2026. The scope covers specified welded or brazed portable cylinders of 4.9–25 litre water capacity made to USDOT 39, Transport Canada 39M or ISO 11118 requirements; seamless non-refillable cylinders are excluded. Listed HTSUS numbers are 7311.00.0060/0090 and potentially 7310.29.0025/0050, but the written scope controls. CBP will continue cash deposits at rates in effect on entry; the notice does not announce one new uniform rate.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢瓶生产商和出口商应立即按结构（焊接/钎焊或无缝）、容积、适用标准、是否带阀以及书面范围复核对美订单，不能仅凭HTS编码判断。报价和合同应沿用企业/组合在入境日适用的反倾销、反补贴保证金安排，并让美国进口商核对CBP指令；“续行”意味着现行令继续，不代表所有企业税率相同，也不应从本公告推算具体税额。
items.impact_en: Review US orders against construction, capacity, standards, valve configuration and the written scope, not HTS codes alone. Price using the producer/exporter combination and cash-deposit instructions applicable on entry; continuation does not create one uniform rate.

items.title_en: US expedites reviews of CTL carbon steel plate measures; comments due 30 November
items.title_original: Cut-to-Length Carbon Steel Plate From China, Russia, and Ukraine; Scheduling of Expedited Five-Year Reviews
items.summary_zh: 美国国际贸易委员会（USITC）在第五次日落复审中决定采用加速程序，审查撤销中国定尺碳钢板反倾销令，以及终止俄罗斯、乌克兰同类产品暂停调查安排，是否会在可预见期间导致美国国内产业实质损害延续或再现。公告称国内产业答复充分、被调查方答复不充分，未发现需要全面复审的其他情形；案件被认定为“特别复杂”，复审期可延长最多90天。非公开工作人员报告拟于2026年11月23日提供给行政保护令名单人员，公开版随后发布；具备资格的当事方书面意见及非当事公众简短陈述原则上于11月30日17:15（美国东部时间）前提交，且不得加入新的事实资料。这是USITC程序安排，不是新税率或撤销措施决定。
items.summary_en: USITC has scheduled expedited fifth sunset reviews of the Chinese CTL carbon steel plate antidumping order and the suspended investigations concerning Russia and Ukraine. Domestic responses were adequate and respondent responses inadequate; the reviews were deemed extraordinarily complicated, permitting an extension of up to 90 days. The non-public staff report is scheduled for 23 November 2026 and eligible written comments are due by 5:15 p.m. ET on 30 November, without new factual information. This is a procedural notice, not a new duty rate or revocation decision.
items.impact_zh: 涉及对美定尺碳钢板业务的中国生产商、出口商和进口商不应把“加速审查”理解为现行反倾销令已经撤销或加税。应由美国案件律师核对当事方资格、行政保护令服务名单、书面意见权限及11月30日提交时限，并按书面产品范围判断具体货物；HTS编码只能辅助，不能替代范围描述。未参与前期答复的主体可能不具备提交评论资格，须逐案确认。
items.impact_en: Do not treat the expedited review as revocation or a new duty. Counsel should verify party eligibility, APO service-list status, filing rights and the 30 November deadline, and assess merchandise against the written scope rather than tariff codes alone.

items.title_en: LME launches USD cash-settled Shanghai hot-rolled coil contract linked to SHFE settlement prices
items.title_original: “LME上海热轧卷板合约”正式上市交易 “上海价格”国际应用场景进一步扩展
items.summary_zh: 上海国际能源交易中心10月29日披露，伦敦金属交易所（LME）已于10月27日上线以上海期货交易所热轧卷板期货结算价为基准的合约。合约代码HS，每手10吨，以美元／吨报价并采用现金结算，提供连续12个月的月度合约；到期结算价以上期所热轧卷板期货次月到期合约在LME合约到期日的结算价为基础，按中国外汇交易中心公布的美元兑人民币中间价换算。LME提供的数据显示，上市首日截至伦敦时间18:00，LMEselect成交880手，叠加办公室交易后当日清算总成交量2513手。
items.summary_en: The Shanghai International Energy Exchange reported on 29 October that the London Metal Exchange launched a contract on 27 October using the Shanghai Futures Exchange hot-rolled coil futures settlement price as its reference. Contract HS is quoted in USD per tonne, cash settled, sized at 10 tonnes per lot and offered in 12 consecutive monthly maturities. Its final settlement is based on the SHFE HRC contract expiring in the following month on the LME expiry date, converted using the CFETS USD/CNY central parity rate. LME data cited by the official release showed 880 lots traded on LMEselect and 2,513 lots cleared in total by 18:00 London time on launch day.
items.impact_zh: 这是交易和风险管理工具上线，不是钢材关税、出口政策或现货指导价。以美元报价中国热卷的钢厂和贸易商可评估其用于订单定价参考或跨市场套保，但现金结算意味着它不能替代实物交割安排，也不能消除人民币／美元换算、上期所与出口现货之间的基差风险。实际使用前应核对经纪商接入、保证金、流动性、结算汇率时点和企业内部套保授权，先以小规模头寸验证套保相关性。
items.impact_en: This is a new trading and risk-management instrument, not a steel tariff, export policy or official spot-price directive. Mills and traders quoting Chinese HRC in US dollars may assess it as a pricing reference or cross-market hedge, but cash settlement does not replace physical-delivery arrangements or remove FX and SHFE-versus-export-spot basis risk. Before use, firms should check broker access, margin, liquidity, the FX conversion timing and internal hedge mandates, and validate hedge correlation with small positions.

items.title_zh: 首钢京唐将改造曹妃甸2号双流板坯连铸机，计划2027年9月投运
items.title_en: Shougang Jingtang plans September 2027 startup for No. 2 slab-caster revamp
items.title_original: Shougang Jingtang selects Primetals for slab caster revamp to improve automotive steel quality
items.summary_zh: Primetals Technologies 10月29日公告称，首钢京唐选择其对河北曹妃甸基地2号双流板坯连铸机实施全面改造，目标是提高汽车钢板坯中心质量、后续轧制质量、浇铸速度和生产率，计划于2027年9月投运。项目包括DynaGap Soft Reduction、LevCon结晶器液位控制、带水平段干式浇铸能力的新导向段、EcoStar Spiral辊及Level 1/Level 2自动化系统。现有设备半径9.5米，冶金长度39.5米、未来可延长至44.26米；板坯规格250毫米×1100—2150毫米，最高浇铸速度1.7米／分钟。公告未披露合同金额、改造后年产能或确定的新增产量。
items.summary_en: Primetals Technologies said on 29 October that Shougang Jingtang selected it for a comprehensive revamp of the No. 2 two-strand slab caster at Caofeidian, with startup scheduled for September 2027. The project adds DynaGap Soft Reduction, LevCon mold-level control, a new strand guide with horizontal dry casting, EcoStar Spiral rolls and new Level 1/2 automation. Existing specifications include a 9.5m radius, 39.5m metallurgical length (44.26m future extension), 250mm by 1,100–2,150mm slabs and speeds up to 1.7m/min. No contract value or post-revamp annual capacity was disclosed.
items.impact_zh: 改造重点是汽车钢板坯质量和过程稳定性，可能提升首钢京唐在汽车外板、内板等高附加值产品上的成材率和一致性，但公告不足以证明新增产能或2027年前供应量变化。汽车钢采购方可在2027年投运和认证阶段关注质量指标、客户验证及爬坡进度；竞争分析不得把设备最高速度或未来冶金长度直接换算成年产量。
items.impact_en: The revamp targets slab quality and process stability for automotive grades and may improve yield and consistency, but the release does not establish added capacity or near-term supply changes. Buyers should monitor commissioning, customer qualification and ramp-up in 2027; equipment speed and metallurgical length should not be converted directly into annual output.

items.title_zh: 印度学者建议为中小企业建立英欧CBAM编码、排放核算与核证支持体系
items.title_en: Indian policy commentary calls for SME support on UK and EU CBAM data and verification
items.title_original: CBAM: Let's get ready
items.summary_zh: 印度贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁大学学者Amita Batra的评论认为，英欧CBAM对中小出口企业的主要障碍是商品编码映射、供应链排放计量、核证能力和碳价减免证明，建议政府或行业协会提供基础设施、培训、技术和融资支持。经官方交叉核对：英国CBAM将于2027年1月1日覆盖铝、水泥、化肥、氢、钢铁；印度CCTS列入英国现行合格碳定价机制清单，但减免仍取决于实际应付碳价及合格证据；间接排放最早到2029年才纳入。英国法规要求核查机构独立并由合格认可机构认可，文章将“Global Accreditation Cooperation正式成员”的要求直接写到核查人员身上并不准确。欧盟证书自2027年2月起购买，首份2026年度申报和证书清缴截止2027年9月30日。文中“180多种下游产品拟扩围”属于政策进程表述，不代表已经纳入现行范围。
items.summary_en: Amita Batra argues that SMEs need public or industry support for product-code mapping, value-chain emissions measurement, verification, finance and training. Official checks confirm that UK CBAM starts on 1 January 2027 and India's CCTS is on the qualifying carbon-pricing list, but relief still depends on actual payable carbon costs and evidence. Indirect emissions are delayed until at least 2029. The article conflates verifier and accreditation-body eligibility: UK law requires an independent verifier accredited by an eligible accreditation body. EU certificates go on sale from February 2027 and the first 2026 declaration/surrender deadline is 30 September 2027. Proposed downstream expansion is not current scope.
items.impact_zh: 对中国中小钢企同样适用的动作是：先按英欧各自8位编码建立产品清单，将工厂、工艺、前体材料、排放年度和客户逐项映射；再选择认可范围覆盖相应钢铁活动的核查机构，并保存境外碳价实际支付证明。英国与欧盟的口径、期限和减免机制不能混成一套模板。行业评论可作为能力建设建议，但不应据此认定中国ETS已自动获得英国减免、欧盟已完成扩围，或某一核查人员天然合格。
items.impact_en: Chinese SMEs should build separate UK and EU code maps, link products to installations, processes, precursors and reporting years, appoint verifiers with the correct steel scope, and retain evidence of carbon prices actually paid. Do not assume automatic relief, completed EU scope expansion or universal verifier eligibility from this commentary.

items.coverage: 2026-10-30已通读Business Standard全文，并对照英国Finance Act 2026、SI 2026/995、GOV.UK合格碳定价机制清单及欧委会CBAM官方页面核对实施时间、行业范围、间接排放、认可/核查关系、证书购买和首份申报期限。本文为作者个人政策评论；未将印度—欧盟FTA时间表或“180多种”扩围说法当成已生效法律。

items.summary_zh: 英国财政部与税务海关总署发布开放咨询，拟在技术可行后尽快把部分炼油产品纳入英国CBAM；这不是已生效扩围，实施时间尚未确定。文件建议初期覆盖15个8位商品编码下的汽油、柴油、航空煤油和煤油：2710 1225、2710 1231、2710 1241、2710 1245、2710 1249、2710 1250、2710 1270、2710 1290、2710 1921、2710 1925、2710 1929、2710 1944、2710 1946、2710 1947、2710 1948；同时征询是否初期排除乙醇和FAME等低碳燃料，并按质量平衡扣除混合燃料中的低碳部分。拟议方法包括装置级统一强度、装置级重新分配以及生产过程级核算；氢可能作为前体计入。炼油产品默认值、原产炼厂/国家证明、行业税率及碳价减免仍待决定。咨询于2027年1月20日23:59截止。
items.summary_en: HM Treasury and HMRC opened a consultation on adding a subset of refinery products to UK CBAM as soon as feasible; no implementation date has been set and the scope expansion is not yet law. The proposal tests 15 eight-digit commodity codes covering petrol, diesel, jet fuel and kerosene: 2710 1225, 2710 1231, 2710 1241, 2710 1245, 2710 1249, 2710 1250, 2710 1270, 2710 1290, 2710 1921, 2710 1925, 2710 1929, 2710 1944, 2710 1946, 2710 1947 and 2710 1948. It asks whether neat low-carbon fuels such as ethanol and FAME should initially be excluded, with mass-balance treatment for blends. Installation-level and process-level emissions methods, hydrogen as a precursor, defaults, origin evidence, a refining-sector rate and carbon-price relief remain under consultation. Responses close at 11:59pm on 20 January 2027.
items.impact_zh: 本咨询不改变2027年起已覆盖钢铁的英国CBAM范围、钢铁税率或申报义务；对中国钢企的直接合规工作仍应按现行钢铁规则推进。间接影响可能来自英国物流、燃料和供应链成本，炼油方法也可能成为未来其他行业扩围的参考。集团如同时向英国出口成品油、经营贸易/仓储或掌握炼厂排放与原产追溯数据，应在2027年1月20日23:59前提交对商品编码、混合燃料质量平衡、炼厂追溯、默认值和成本传导的证据；不能据咨询稿预估确定税额。
items.impact_en: The consultation does not change the existing UK CBAM scope, rate or compliance duties for iron and steel from 2027. Steel exporters should continue preparing under the enacted steel rules. Indirect effects may arise through UK fuel, logistics and supply-chain costs, and the refinery methodology may inform later scope expansion. Groups that also export refined fuels, trade or store them, or hold refinery emissions/origin data should submit evidence on codes, blend mass balance, refinery traceability, defaults and cost pass-through by 11:59pm on 20 January 2027. Do not price a definite charge from this consultation.
items.source_excerpt: This consultation seeks views on the feasibility and impacts of CBAM sectoral scope expansion to refinery products. At Budget 2025, the government confirmed that it is considering the impacts and feasibility of including refinery products in CBAM in future. This consultation is the next stage of that ongoing assessment. This consultation is being undertaken jointly by His Majesty’s Revenue & Customs (HMRC) and His Majesty’s Treasury (HMT). The government invites views from interested parties, including the importers and their agents, other businesses, individuals, tax advisers, trade and professional bodies and other interested parties, including those overseas. items.title_en: Japan decides five-year definitive anti-dumping duties on Chinese and Taiwanese nickel-added cold-rolled stainless steel from 31 October
items.title_original: Japan to Impose Anti-Dumping Duties of Up to 42.1% on Chinese, Taiwanese Stainless Steel Plate for 5 Years from Oct. 31
items.summary_zh: 日本财务省10月27日宣布，内阁已决定对原产于或从中国、台湾出口的镍系冷轧不锈钢带及冷轧板征收最终反倾销税；政令拟于10月30日公布，课税期为2026年10月31日至2031年10月30日。调查范围为含铬10.5%以上、镍0.6%以上的合金钢，涉及HS 7219.31—7219.35、7219.90、7220.20及7220.90项下22个税目。中国山西太钢及未抽样合作企业税率为27.7%，浦项（张家港）不锈钢（PZSS）及其他供应商为42.1%；台湾YUSCO及未抽样企业为3.6%，Walsin及其他供应商为20.1%。最终税率与7月9日起的临时税率相同。
items.summary_en: Japan's Ministry of Finance announced on 27 October that the Cabinet had decided definitive anti-dumping duties on nickel-added cold-rolled stainless steel coil, sheet and strip originating in or exported from China and Taiwan. The Cabinet Order is due to be promulgated on 30 October and duties will apply from 31 October 2026 through 30 October 2031. Scope covers alloy steel with at least 10.5% chromium and more than 0.6% nickel under 22 tariff lines within HS 7219.31-7219.35, 7219.90, 7220.20 and 7220.90. Rates are 27.7% for Shanxi Taigang and cooperating non-sampled Chinese suppliers, 42.1% for PZSS and other Chinese suppliers, 3.6% for YUSCO and cooperating non-sampled Taiwanese suppliers, and 20.1% for Walsin and other Taiwanese suppliers. These rates are unchanged from the provisional measure.
items.impact_zh: 这是已由日本内阁决定、即将公布并按明确日期实施的最终措施，不是提案。向日本出口相关冷轧不锈钢的中国钢厂和贸易商应在10月31日前按制造商身份、原产地/出口地和日本税目逐票复核适用税率；尤其不要把27.7%合作税率误用于PZSS或未获该待遇的供应商。报价和合同应明确反倾销税承担、在途货物清关日期及错误归类风险，并保存材质成分、宽度、轧制状态、制造商和原产地证明。该措施仅覆盖上述镍系冷轧不锈钢范围，不能外推到所有不锈钢板材。
items.impact_en: This is a definitive measure decided by Japan's Cabinet with a specified implementation date, not a proposal. Chinese mills and traders shipping covered cold-rolled stainless steel to Japan should verify the producer, origin/export route and Japanese tariff classification shipment by shipment before 31 October. Do not apply the 27.7% cooperating rate to PZSS or suppliers not entitled to it. Contracts and quotations should allocate anti-dumping duty, customs-clearance timing and misclassification risk, while retaining composition, width, rolling condition, producer and origin evidence. The measure covers the specified nickel-added cold-rolled products only, not all stainless plate.
